stem.text: An electron is situated in a vacuum between two charged plates, as shown.

stem.alt: Two parallel charged plates: the upper plate has minus signs along it and the lower plate has plus signs along it. An electron, labelled electron, is between the plates on a vertical line.

stem.text: Which statement describes the motion of the electron due to the uniform electric field?

A.text: It moves downwards with a constant acceleration.

B.text: It moves downwards with zero acceleration.

C.text: It moves upwards with a constant acceleration.

D.text: It moves upwards with a decreasing acceleration.
